note: LB.12 identity fixture (legacy-only, no matrix cell). A contract op is scoped by the DIRECTORY + STEM of the file that declares it (`contract::<dir>::...::<stem>::<METHOD>:<path>`, James 2026-09-19), and a markdown DOC_SECTION likewise (`docs::<dir>::...::<stem>::<slug>`): two services' openapi.yaml files keep one op node each, while the openapi.yaml + openapi.json twin in one directory stays ONE set of ops (the A10.8 intent). A root-level file's qnames are unchanged. Baseline 2026-09-19 (installed leap wheel, HEAD 1e82ac3): all three files declaring GET /orders share one DOC_SECTION `contract::openapi::GET:/orders`, and docs/orders/guide.md + docs/billing/guide.md share `docs::guide::setup` - nodes 1/6, DOCUMENTS 0/3, POSITION 0/2, FORBID VIOLATIONS 2.
